spec: docs/cuas2/spec.md sections 5, 6.6 (a)-(o) and 1.3; inputs are what the feeder saw, trace what the python twin produced
note: trace = change lists of the discrete outputs, events [t, code, arg], acks [t, result], and one CRC32 per 100 ticks of the continuous outputs

vectors.name: a_nominal_two_shots
vectors.desc: (a) nominal shots: two accepted FIREs 500 ms apart, one stroke and one exit each

vectors.name: b_not_spun
vectors.desc: (b) FIRE while the wheels are still ramping -> NOT_SPUN, nothing fed

vectors.name: c_no_ball
vectors.desc: (c) the staged ball is gone (breech reads clear) -> NO_BALL

vectors.name: d_not_clear
vectors.desc: (d) the muzzle beam is blocked from power-up -> NOT_CLEAR

vectors.name: e_sector_abort
vectors.desc: (e) sector lost 20 ms into the stroke (aborted, EVENT 11+9); a second one lost 90 ms in (past the breech clear at ~71 ms: the ball leaves)

vectors.name: f_deadman_drop
vectors.desc: (f) dead-man drops 15 ms into the stroke -> abort before commit, the ball stays staged

vectors.name: g_no_exit_jam
vectors.desc: (g) the ball never leaves the barrel -> FAULT no_exit at 250 ms, KICK stops, CLEAR_FAULT re-homes

vectors.name: h_unexpected_exit
vectors.desc: (h) a muzzle pulse with no feed -> FAULT unexpected_exit + shot_overcount, KICK stops, FIRE answers JAMMED

vectors.name: i_interval_clamp
vectors.desc: (i) cfg min interval 100 ms is clamped to 470 (the 466 ms cycle): FIRE at +468 ms (re-staged since +466) is TOO_SOON, at +480 ms accepted

vectors.name: j_overspeed
vectors.desc: (j) one ESC runs away to 22,700 rpm -> FAULT overspeed 20 ms above 1.05 x cap, DShot 0, KICK stops

vectors.name: k_telemetry_loss
vectors.desc: (k) the eRPM replies stop -> FAULT telemetry_lost after 50 ms, wheels 0, KICK stops

vectors.name: l_estop_pre_commit
vectors.desc: (l) E-stop 20 ms into the stroke -> FEED_ABORT rail, nothing leaves; released later the gate re-homes and the ball is staged again

vectors.name: l2_estop_post_commit
vectors.desc: (l2) E-stop 105 ms into the stroke (the ball is in the nip): it still leaves

vectors.name: m_watchdog_trip
vectors.desc: (m) heartbeat lost 15 ms into the stroke (the 300 ms watchdog -> SAFE): abort; FIRE afterwards is INHIBIT

vectors.name: n_feed_req_stuck
vectors.desc: (n) FEED_REQ stuck high in the limiter (second edge ignored): the rod never leaves home -> FAULT pusher_stuck at 40 ms, no commit

vectors.name: o_empty_hopper
vectors.desc: (o) empty hopper: 3 failed loads -> EVENT EMPTY once, FIRE -> NO_BALL; refilled, the next retry stages a ball and FIRE works

vectors.name: p_pusher_stuck_extended
vectors.desc: (row 6) pusher servo stuck extended after the stroke -> FAULT pusher_stuck at 330 ms

vectors.name: q_breech_double
vectors.desc: (row 11) the breech stays blocked 30 ms too long after the rod passed it (2-ball pocket) -> FAULT breech_double

vectors.name: r_gate_stuck_bore
vectors.desc: (row 9) gate stuck at the bore -> LOAD hall never seen -> FAULT gate_stuck

vectors.name: s_wheel_not_ready
vectors.desc: (row 16) one ESC fails to spin -> FIRE NOT_SPUN, FAULT wheel_not_ready after 1.5 s

vectors.name: t_inhibit_abort
vectors.desc: (row 24) the app sets FIRE_INHIBIT 25 ms into the stroke -> abort before commit

vectors.name: u_wheels_abort
vectors.desc: the speed request drops 10 ms into the stroke -> wheels out of window -> abort

vectors.name: v_gates_interlock_range
vectors.desc: FIRE with the E-stop open -> INTERLOCK; out of the sector -> RANGE; with FIRE_INHIBIT -> INHIBIT

vectors.name: w_breech_early_clear
vectors.desc: the staged ball vanishes 10 ms into the stroke (breech clears early) -> abort (beam)

vectors.name: x_second_exit
vectors.desc: a ghost muzzle pulse 100 ms after a good exit -> FAULT unexpected_exit (+ shot_overcount), KICK stops

vectors.name: y_diff_override
vectors.desc: FLYWHEEL differential +30 permille: the bottom wheel runs faster; one shot at the window

vectors.name: z_pusher_dead
vectors.desc: (row 7) pusher dead: the rod never leaves home -> FAULT pusher_stuck at 40 ms

vectors.name: aa_busy_fire
vectors.desc: a second FIRE 50 ms into the stroke -> BUSY (gate_state is not STAGED)

vectors.name: ab_push_not_home
vectors.desc: the staged ball is there but the pusher does not read home -> FIRE answers JAMMED

vectors.name: ac_commit_on_breech_clear
vectors.desc: (F3) the dead-man drops 3 ms after the breech cleared (74 ms in, before the 105 ms commit): no abort, the ball leaves and is counted

vectors.name: ad_wheels_leave_window_late
vectors.desc: (F2) the speed request drops 50 ms into the stroke, the wheels leave the window before the breech clears -> abort

vectors.name: ae_retract_without_push_home
vectors.desc: (F4) the pusher never reads home after the stroke: the gate must not move -> FAULT pusher_stuck at 330 ms

vectors.name: af_gate_precedence
vectors.desc: ACK precedence of the feeder layer (spec 5.5), one FIRE each: E-stop + inhibit + out of sector -> INTERLOCK; dead-man + out of sector -> INHIBIT; heartbeat lost alone -> INHIBIT; dead-man alone -> INHIBIT
